evals.prompt: I fixed a logic bug in the totals function. What guard should I leave?
evals.expectedBehavior: Leave a regression test that pins the corrected behavior (the failing test that now passes) and record it in the ledger guard field.

evals.prompt: Leave a guard for this UI hydration fix.
evals.expectedBehavior: Leave a layer-appropriate UI guard (interaction + console assertion). If the layer is ASSIST, record a gap-log / handoff instead of claiming an automated guard.

evals.prompt: How do I guard a System bug whose fix lives in CI config?
evals.expectedBehavior: Leave a CI check or instrumented-boundary assertion as the guard artifact and link it from the ledger.

evals.prompt: Write the user-facing documentation for our product.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger regression-guard — this is documentation authoring, not leaving a post-fix guard.

evals.prompt: Design a database schema for a new app.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger regression-guard — there is no fix to guard against regressing.
